text:
The fluffy things in the sky that rain comes from are clouds.

The mood conveyed in the text is wistful, cozy, and serene. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by emphasizing a sense of peaceful transition and nostalgia. By describing the autumn park as a "festival of colors" and highlighting the "cozy promise of the coming winter," the text invites the reader to appreciate the beauty of change rather than fear it. The slow pace and warm imagery create an emotional connection to the season, framing the arrival of winter not as an end, but as a comforting and anticipated event.
